job.title: Store Manager
description: About Harborline Outfitters
Harborline is a 140-store outdoor and lifestyle retailer. Our omnichannel team uses machine learning to forecast demand, so the right gear is on your shelves before the season starts.
The role
As Store Manager you own the store: sales, people, operations and the customer experience. You will lead a team of 25–40 associates and two assistant managers.
What you'll do
- Drive sales and profitability; own the store P&L, payroll budget and shrink results
- Recruit, hire, train and coach associates and assistant managers
- Build schedules that match traffic and keep the store within its labor budget
- Keep the store visually merchandised to company standards and execute floor sets
- Partner with the District Manager on performance and growth plans
Requirements
- 3+ years of retail management experience in a high-volume store
- Experience owning or contributing to a store P&L
- Proven record hiring and developing a team
- Open availability, including nights, weekends and holidays
- Ability to lift 40 lbs and stand for a full shift
- High school diploma or GED required; bachelor's degree preferred
Nice to have
- Experience with Workday scheduling
- Bilingual in Spanish
Pay and benefits
$62,000 – $72,000 per year plus a quarterly bonus. Medical, dental, 401(k) with match, 30% employee discount.
